title: Record read-only Space email readiness and honest pilot exclusions
detail: Read-only operator command records exact source commit, generated schema contract checks, redacted configuration presence, validated dated aggregate pilot observations and explicit missing live-schema/provider/mailbox evidence. Unknown/denied consent remains excluded; granted is only an upper bound. No sender/database imports, sends, queries/writes or DNS changes. Prior observation never claimed as fresh. Runbook and package entry integrate evidence capture. Baseline closure does not claim provider readiness, eligible campaign audience, preview/production deployment or owner test completion.

verify.note: Behavior and CLI mutation tests require 520 unknown contacts excluded; refuse recipient PII, bad tenant/counts and future timestamps; secrets redacted; missing source/schema exits nonzero; real CLI records source commit and explicitly unverified live gates.
